Empty hands and later deaths consume their frozen positions and are skipped without replacement.

Each participant privately chooses one actual Hand card and publicly shows it before the consequence. Freeze its effective suit/color at revelation. After accepting the seated route, source loss does not revoke it. Finish issued movement and its children before proceeding. Owner death or terminal victory stops future participant operations. Never retrieve a revealed entity that has left its actual Hand source.

Only black entities actually received into the owner's Hand receive the shared exact-card actual-turn hand-limit exemption. Reuse its native store and expiry. The legacy judgment-origin slot is 0 because this is a reveal/gain; no judgment frame or judgment event is fabricated.
